finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker can inject a malicious filename that leads to OS command execution.
finding.assumptions: The filename is directly used to open a file, and there is no validation or sanitization.

finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.trigger: An attacker can inject special characters or command sequences into the candidate or party strings.
finding.assumptions: The candidate and party strings are directly used without any validation or sanitization.

finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

finding.assumptions: The vote string is directly used without any validation or sanitization.
